# About FlowProbe

Source: user-guide/concepts/about

## What it is

The **About FlowProbe** screen presents the About FlowProbe page of the application. The screen is at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/about`.

The screen has the **Edge cases** section.

![The About FlowProbe screen](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-about-1/0.png)

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/about`.

# Team dashboard

Source: user-guide/concepts/dashboard

## What it is

The **Team Dashboard** screen shows the team dashboard for your account. It is captured in the screenshot below.

![The Team Dashboard screen](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-dashboard-1/0.png)

## Where to find it

On the **Preferences** screen, click **Dashboard**. The screen is at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/dashboard`.

## Actions on this screen

- **Refresh**

## Related

- [Manage account preferences overview](../overviews/manage-account-preferences.md) — the feature this screen belongs to.

# Notifications

Source: user-guide/concepts/notification

## What it is

The **Notifications** screen shows the list of notifications, each with its Read or Unread status.

![The Notifications screen](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-notifications-1/0.png)

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/notifications`.

## Statuses you may see

- **Unread**
- **Read**

These are the values seen on this screen; others may exist.

## Actions on this screen

- **Mark all read**

## Related

- [Manage notifications overview](../overviews/manage-notifications.md) — the feature this screen belongs to.

# Projects

Source: user-guide/concepts/project

## What it is

The **Projects** screen shows the list of projects in a table with project, owner, status, and deadline information.

You can filter the list with a search input that has the placeholder `Filter projects`.

![The Projects screen. Some form field values are hidden for privacy.](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-projects-1/0.png)

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/projects`.

## On this screen

- **Project**
- **Owner**
- **Status**
- **Deadline**

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Filter projects** | search | no |

## Statuses you may see

- **active**
- **review**
- **blocked**
- **done**

These are the values seen on this screen; others may exist.

## Actions on this screen

- **Load more**

# Settings

Source: user-guide/concepts/setting

## What it is

The **Preferences** screen shows a form for managing account preferences, with theme, language, notification frequency, two-factor authentication, and display name settings. It is part of the manage account preferences feature.

![The Preferences screen with its form fields](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-settings-1/0.png)

## Where to find it

On the **Team Dashboard** screen, click **Settings**. The screen is at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/settings`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Theme** | radio group | no | Light, Dark, System |
| **Language** | select | no | — |
| **Notification frequency** | select | no | — |
| **Enable two-factor authentication** | checkbox | no | — |
| **Display name** | text | yes | — |

- **Display name**: the placeholder reads "Jane Doe".

## Actions on this screen

- **Save**

## Related

- [Manage account preferences overview](../overviews/manage-account-preferences.md) — the feature this screen belongs to.

# Team

Source: user-guide/concepts/team

## What it is

The **Team** screen shows a table of your team members with `Name`, `Role` and `Status` columns.

![The Team screen](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-team-1/0.png)

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/team`.

## On this screen

- **Name**
- **Role**
- **Status**

## Statuses you may see

- **Active**
- **Away**
- **Offline**

These are the values seen on this screen; others may exist.

## Actions on this screen

- **+ Invite**
- **View activity**

## Screenshots

![After you click View](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-team-1/1.png)

## Related

- [Manage team members overview](../overviews/manage-team-members.md) — the feature this screen belongs to.

# Manage account preferences overview

Source: user-guide/overviews/manage-account-preferences

## What it is

Manage account preferences covers the **Team dashboard** and **Settings** screens.

The **Team dashboard** screen shows a **Refresh** control that runs a Refresh action.

:::note
This statement could not be confirmed against the project's own sources. Treat it as unverified.
:::

The **Settings** screen shows a **Save** control that runs a Save action; **Save** was disabled when the screen was captured, before its inputs were filled.

:::note
This statement could not be confirmed against the project's own sources. Treat it as unverified.
:::

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/dashboard`.

## What you can do

- [Team dashboard](../concepts/dashboard.md)
- [Settings](../concepts/setting.md)

## Screenshots

![Team Dashboard](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-dashboard-1/0.png)

![Before you fill it in. Some form field values are hidden for privacy.](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-settings-1/0.png)

# Manage notifications overview

Source: user-guide/overviews/manage-notifications

## What it is

Manage Notifications shows the status badges and actions for your notifications.

The **Notifications** screen shows `Unread` and `Read` status badges and a **Mark all read** control.

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/notifications`.

## What you can do

- [Notifications](../concepts/notification.md)

# Manage team members overview

Source: user-guide/overviews/manage-team-members

## What it is

Manage team members is the feature where you see the people in your team and invite new ones.

The **Team** screen shows the **Name**, **Role**, and **Status** columns and the **+ Invite** control.

The **Team member** screen shows the **View activity** control and **Active** and **done** badges.

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/team`.

## What you can do

- [Team](../concepts/team.md)
- [Invite team](../tasks/invite-team.md)

## Screenshots

![Team](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-team-1/0.png)

![After you click View](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-team-1/1.png)

# Review notifications overview

Source: user-guide/overviews/review-notifications

## What it is

Review Notifications is the notifications feature of the application.

The **Review Notifications** screen shows status badges, such as `Unread` and `Read`, and provides a **Mark all read** control and action.

## Where to find it

Open `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/notifications`.

## Get started

Start with [Mark all read](../tasks/mark-all-read.md).

:::note
This statement could not be confirmed against the project's own sources. Treat it as unverified.
:::

## What you can do

- [Mark all read](../tasks/mark-all-read.md)

# Create a new report

Source: user-guide/tasks/create-report

## Steps

1. On the **Create a new report** screen, click **Next**.

    ![The Create a new report screen with a Report title field and a Next control](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-create-report-1/0.png)

:::note
This statement could not be confirmed against the project's own sources. Treat it as unverified.
:::

2. Enter a title in **Report title**.

3. Click **Next**.

# Invite a team member

Source: user-guide/tasks/invite-flowprobe-screenshot-app

## Steps

1. Open `flowprobe-screenshot-app/invite`.
2. Enter your teammate's email address in **Email**.
   ![Invite a team member form with some field values hidden for privacy](screenshots/flowprobe-screenshot-app-invite-1/0.png)
3. Select a role in **Role**.
4. Click **Invite**.

The other fields (**Send welcome email**, **Access expires**, **Seat limit**) are optional.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Email** | email | yes |
| **Role** | select | no |
| **Send welcome email** | checkbox | no |
| **Access expires** | date | no |
| **Seat limit** | number | no |

- **Seat limit**: minimum value 0.
